chronology: Prophet era -> Hijri chronology -> present day -> future catalog additions
provider_policy: provider-neutral catalogued-source failover; no source is privileged or mandatory
storage_policy: one physical PDF copy per book across complementary primary/secondary shards
quality_policy: technical quality and completeness gate before persistence; source PDF is never rewritten
rights_policy: acquisition is separate from public redistribution; rights-unknown remains protected/private
resume_policy: persistent chronological queue; every run resumes pending books and preserves per-book attempt state
chronology_policy: explicit Hijri chronology metadata first; author death Hijri fallback; future additions always remain after present-day material
hosted_runtime_policy: each hosted job is a resumable execution slice; automatic continuation is required and the queue itself never ends because of a book-count target
